description: This file contains utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization ID generation and decryption, specifically using AES-128-ECB encryption with CryptoJS. It also exports a function to validate the tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray object for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates a unique organization ID by encrypting a normalized email address with a tenant salt-derived AES key.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted, URL-encoded organization ID back to the email, useful for local debugging.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks whether the tenant salt is set and non-empty.
